step0.title: Glad you're here.
step0.body: Mensaena is your place for lived neighbourhood help. In six short steps we show you how to settle in safely and effortlessly.

step1.title: Everything at a glance.
step1.body: On the dashboard you find all key info at a glance: new requests, offers from your neighbourhood, and personal recommendations.

step2.title: Help nearby.
step2.body: On the interactive map you see where help is needed or offered near you. Tap a pin and meet your neighbours.

step3.title: Share what you can offer or seek.
step3.body: Whether you're lending tools, helping with shopping or needing support — a post takes only seconds.

step4.title: Talk directly with each other.
step4.body: Everything between neighbours runs via secure direct messages. Friendly, respectful, GDPR-compliant.

step5.title: Stronger together.
step5.body: Mensaena thrives on togetherness. Be respectful, helpful and open — you'll soon feel how warm your neighbourhood is.

templateTexts.i18nCheck: Check all translations for missing keys and unnatural wording across all 7 languages and fix them.
templateTexts.perfCheck: Analyze the app for performance issues (unnecessary rebuilds, missing stream limits) and fix them.
templateTexts.darkMode: Add a dark mode toggle in settings and make sure every screen supports it.
templateTexts.a11y: Improve accessibility: contrast, touch target sizes and screen reader labels.
templateTexts.onboarding: Improve the onboarding flow for new users: clearer steps, better explanations and a motivating completion page.
templateTexts.security: Review all RLS rules and security configurations — identify and close security gaps.
templateTexts.animations: Add subtle, elegant animations to the main screens: smooth transitions, hero animations and feedback effects.
templateTexts.crashes: Analyze the most common crashes and errors in the app and fix the most critical ones.
templateTexts.dependencies: Update all outdated dependencies to the latest stable versions and fix compatibility issues.
templateTexts.notifications: Improve the push notification flow: better texts, smart scheduling and grouped notifications.
templateTexts.offline: Improve offline functionality: meaningful error messages, local caching of important data and sync after reconnect.
templateTexts.emptyStates: Add appealing empty states with illustrations, motivating texts and calls to action to all screens.

firstAid.title: First aid (offline)
firstAid.offlineHint: This guide works without an internet connection.
firstAid.emergencyHint: When in doubt, always call emergency services first.
firstAid.disclaimer: These notes do not replace medical training. In a real emergency follow the dispatcher's instructions.
firstAid.recovery1: Turn an unconscious but breathing person onto their side.
firstAid.recovery2: Bend the upper leg, place their hand under the cheek.
firstAid.recovery3: Tilt the head back, open the mouth slightly — keeps the airway clear.
firstAid.recovery4: Keep checking breathing until the ambulance arrives.
firstAid.cpr1: No normal breathing? Call emergency and start CPR immediately.
firstAid.cpr2: Heel of one hand on the centre of the chest, second hand on top.
firstAid.cpr3: Push hard 30 times about 5–6 cm deep, rate ~100–120/min.
firstAid.cpr4: Keep going until help arrives or the person moves.
firstAid.bleeding1: Press directly on the wound — with a cloth or bare hand.
firstAid.bleeding2: Apply a pressure bandage, raise the affected limb.
firstAid.bleeding3: For life-threatening bleeding call emergency immediately.
firstAid.burn1: Cool immediately for 10–20 minutes with hand-warm water.
firstAid.burn2: No home remedies (oil, flour, toothpaste) on the wound.
firstAid.burn3: Don't open blisters, cover loosely and sterile.

battery.title: Receive calls reliably
battery.body: So calls and important messages reach you instantly even when the app is closed, exempt Mensaena from battery optimization. Otherwise Android may stop the app in the background.
battery.samsungBody:
So calls reach you instantly even when the app is closed, Samsung needs two steps:
1. Exclude Mensaena from battery optimization (tap »Allow« in the next dialog).
2. In App settings → Battery → choose »Unrestricted« and remove Mensaena from »Sleeping apps«.

rationales.intro: So Mensaena works smoothly, we'll briefly ask for a few permissions. You decide what's OK — we only use them when you trigger something yourself.

notification.title: So you don't miss anything important
notification.body: Calls from neighbours, new messages and help requests — without notifications you won't see them. We never nag with ads, only the real stuff.

camera.title: For photos, videos & video calls
camera.body: Posts with your own pictures, your profile picture, face-to-face with neighbours. The camera only activates when you start it yourself.

microphone.title: So others can hear you
microphone.body: Voice and video calls, voice messages and livestreams need the microphone. It's only active when you speak yourself.

photos.title: Pictures from your gallery
photos.body: For posts, your profile and sharing with neighbours. We only access what you pick yourself.

audio.title: Audio from your library
audio.body: So you can attach voice clips, music and sound files straight from your device in chats and posts.

location.title: Find neighbours nearby
location.body: Mensaena thrives on what's around you — help, swaps, meetups, emergencies. Without location you just see an empty map.

nearby.title: Bluetooth headset for calls
nearby.body: So your headphones or earbuds are picked up automatically when you call someone. We NEVER ask for location.

phone.title: Calls like WhatsApp
phone.body: So incoming calls appear as real fullscreen ringing on the lock screen — even when the app is closed.

fullscreenCall.title: Calls in true fullscreen
fullscreenCall.body: So incoming calls take over the whole display — like WhatsApp. Without this permission you only see a small banner at the top.

overlay.title: Show calls over other apps
overlay.body: So Mensaena appears on a call no matter which app is open — also on the lock screen. Exactly the behavior you know from WhatsApp.

download.title: Install Mensaena
download.headline:
Get Mensaena
as a real app.
download.lede: Two ways on Android: F-Droid (recommended, auto-updates from our repo) or a direct APK download. No data to Google. Open source.
download.fdroidDesc: F-Droid is an open-source app store. If it's installed, the button opens our repo directly — confirm the fingerprint, subscribe, done.
download.step3: Tap “+” and enter the repo URL
download.apkDesc: Signed APK from GitHub Releases — always the latest version. No automatic updates: you install manually when a new build ships.
download.whyDesc: Mensaena is open source and ad-free. We share no data with Google, so no Play Store. F-Droid verifies every version independently — you don't have to trust us blindly.
